ACMA Offline RRL - Link

The ACMA Offline RRL can be accessed here; https://web.acma.gov.au/offline-rrl/

The ACMA Offline RRL is a web application that will allow you to perform searches against the ACMA downloadable RRL spectra_rrl.zip (this zip file). Once you have loaded the Offline RRL in your browser, and imported RRL data (spectra_rrl.zip file), you will no longer require an internet connection. That is, you can reopen the Offline RRL at times when you are offline, without an internet connection, even if you close and reopen your browser. Ie, once initially loaded, the page; https://web.acma.gov.au/offline-rrl/ will be able to be reopened in your browser without being connected to the internet, so you should consider bookmarking this link. Then you can search the ACMA RRL at times you are offline.

The Offline RRL allows you to perform a variety of searches against the RRL data, navigate, chart and map that data. You can also further extract this data in CSV or KML format. You can customise output and also perform core text based, technical and SQL searches. And at times you have an internet connection, you may be able incrementally update your offline database to bring it up to near live ACMA data. The Offline RRL allows you to perform powerful searches against the full RRL dataset, so you may wish to consider using this application even if you do not intend to work offline.

Please send enquiries about the ACMA Offline RRL directly to; info@acma.gov.au .
